decisions.evidence: Verification 2.1 applied F4, whose exact Statement requires both limits, after proving only the h_0 limit. Step 1.1 places the support in r<=4R0. The repair proves equality of metrics and first derivatives on r>4R0, equality of all sphere integrals for R>4R0 and therefore existence of the h_epsilon limit before F4. Full bump smoothness, positivity, end decay and scalar-curvature calculation and four suppliers were independently checked; claim and dependencies are unchanged.
